mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from GEO for FAQ Pages optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline to see results from GEO for FAQ Pages optimization can vary, but generally, you can expect to start noticing improvements within 3 to 6 months. Initial changes might be seen sooner, but significant shifts in local search rankings and organic traffic often require search engines to recrawl and re-index your updated content. Factors influencing this timeframe include the competitiveness of your local market, the authority of your website, and the thoroughness of your optimization efforts. Consistent monitoring and further refinement can accelerate the process.
